[/color][/b][color=#c9daf8]- The first house upgrade is now improved! It includes a bathroom, kitchen, spouse room, living room, and attic and basement.

[color=#b6d7a8][size=5][b]FEATURES:[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#b6d7a8]- The starter home features a fully functional kitchen and bathroom which contains a tub for you to refill your energy!

- The first house upgrade [u]NOW FEATURES[/u] a foyer, a kitchen, bathroom, bedroom and the spouse room. It also includes and attic and a basement.

- The second house upgrade [u]MIGHT[/u] feature a foyer, a hallway leading to the living room which would have two hallways, one leading to the kitchen and one leading to the master bedroom. There will also be a staircase leading to the children's room, and two other empty rooms for customization.

- All Farmhouses are compatible with recolors! :D

-Feel free to suggest some ideas for my mod! And if you want something to be modded, let me know!
